_comment: Hand-maintained delivery evidence, merged into the generated matrix by tools/build-rtm.py. One entry per requirement that an iteration commits to. Evidence should name the test or artifact that proves it, once it exists.

CAP-SCM-001.evidence: EpiBundleReader plus the store conformance suite run against both the in-memory store and HAPI; coded section typing is a later iteration

CAP-SCM-007.evidence: ADR-015 plus FN-CC-002/003/007 for documents and FN-CC-008/009 for sections; reusable-unit identity is a later iteration

CAP-SCM-010.evidence: FN_CC_006 and IT_001, the latter run against both the in-memory store and a real HAPI server; validation against the pinned profile is PR 5

CAP-VAL-003.evidence: FN_VAL_001 and FN_VAL_002 at the write gate; other gates (ingest, pre-approval, pre-publish) arrive with the capabilities that own them

CAP-VAL-005.evidence: FN_VAL_003 and IT_005: issues carry severity and a FHIRPath location; severity configurability per gate and market is CAP-VAL-007, later

CAP-IAM-001.evidence: FN_IAM_001 plus bearer authentication on every content endpoint (IT_007); federation and MFA are the identity provider's, per CAP-IAM-001

CAP-IAM-002.evidence: FN_IAM_002 and FN_IAM_003, IT_002 against real OPA, and enforcement on every content endpoint; other capabilities enforce as they arrive

CAP-IAM-007.evidence: FN_IAM_004 on every store operation, reached through the API; physical partitioning for residency markets is ADR-004, later

CAP-IAM-009.evidence: FN_AUD_004: decisions recorded whether allowed or denied; administration changes are recorded when that surface exists

CAP-AUD-001.evidence: FN_AUD_001 and IT_003 for content writes and access decisions; other capabilities write as they arrive

CAP-AUD-002.evidence: FN_AUD_002 and FN_AUD_003: append-only by interface, and enforced by the database in the PostgreSQL sink; sealed WORM export is capability 22

CAP-CFG-001.evidence: MarketCatalogue with FN_CFG_002 profile binding; lifecycle, workflow and rule config are later iterations

CAP-CFG-004.evidence: IT_004_a_new_market_is_added_by_configuration_alone; a market carries no behaviour until PR 6 consumes it

CAP-EVT-001.evidence: FN_EVT_001, FN_EVT_002 and IT_008: emission only, against an in-memory publisher; the broker adapter and delivery guarantees are later

CAP-LCM-001.evidence: FN_LCM_001/002 and IT_010: model loaded from configuration and unpermitted transitions refused

CAP-LCM-003.evidence: FN_LCM_004 and IT_013: per-market regulatory-approval state in its own model, store and service, with a test that a market transition leaves internal state untouched. Effective dating (CAP-LCM-004) and the durable store follow

CAP-LCM-007.evidence: FN_LCM_003: transitions recorded with actor, time and reason; workflow routing is a later PR

CAP-WFL-003.evidence: FN_WFL_003 and IT_012: a gate the model says must be signed accepts only a signature by the transitioning actor, over that version, meaning what the gate requires, and not already spent. Signature at gates other than approval arrives with the workflow routing that owns them

CAP-WFL-005.evidence: IT_011 for the approval gate; routing and escalation are later

CAP-AUD-003.evidence: ADR-020 plus FN_AUD_005, FN_WFL_003 and IT_012: the manifest binds signer, printed name, meaning, time and a SHA-256 hash of the version, every signing attempt is audited, and the approval gate accepts only a valid, unspent signature by the transitioning actor. The durable signature store is still to come; today they are held in memory

CAP-IAM-006.evidence: IT_011: the author of a version cannot approve it, enforced in the one path every transition takes
